Card.Name: Disable SwitchBack Compatibility Policy
Card.Description: SwitchBack is a Windows compatibility feature that lets newer applications receive compatibility fixes originally designed for older OS versions. On a modern Windows 11 system running only current software, this feature usually has no practical effect. This policy disables it.
Card.FriendlyDescription: SwitchBack is a Windows compatibility feature that lets newer applications receive compatibility fixes originally designed for older OS versions. On a modern Windows 11 system running only current software, this feature usually has no practical effect. This policy disables it.
Card.WhatWeKnowSummary: Claim: SwitchBack is a Windows compatibility feature that lets newer applications receive compatibility fixes originally designed for older OS versions. On a modern Windows 11 system running only current software, this feature usually has no practical effect. This policy disables it.
